question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 dissolved copper, does the Part I limits table establish any enforceable numeric discharge limit (30-day average or daily maximum) against which reported measurements may be compared for compliance, or does it impose only a reporting obligation without an applicable numeric limit?
required_context: Outfall 001 limits table column structure distinguishing DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS (mg/l 30-Day Avg and Daily Max) from MONITORING REQUIREMENTS
Dissolved Copper row entries of N/A in lbs/day columns and Report in both mg/l limitation columns
Adjacent pollutant rows for contrast (e.g., Total Copper with numeric 0.011 mg/l limits; Total Suspended Solids with Report in one mg/l column and a numeric limit in the other)
source_locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 limits table, Dissolved Copper row
notes: The nominated row places Report rather than numeric values in the mg/l discharge-limitation columns. Purpose A must distinguish enforceable numeric limits from report-only parameters; resolving how Report functions in those columns determines whether dissolved copper measurements are subject to numeric exceedance evaluation.
